summary: Finds one of the project's triggers by its id.
description: Apps Script hands out a trigger id when a trigger is created but offers no way to look one up again, so the project's triggers are walked and compared. A trigger that has since been deleted gives `null`, which is the case a stored id has to handle.

params.id: The trigger id. It must not be empty.

returns: the trigger, or `null` when the project has none with that id.

throws.EmptyStringException: the id is not a string, or is empty.

examples.title: Looking up
